hints.title: Count Unique Word Occurrences
hints.text: For each response, split into words and use a set so each response increments a feature count at most once.

hints.title: Track Original Indices
hints.text: Record the original index of each feature to break ties in popularity stably.

hints.title: Stable Sort by Popularity
hints.text: Sort features descending by response frequency, and ascending by initial feature index on tie.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all responses for each feature repeatedly takes O(F * R * W) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set lookup per response word aggregates counts in linear O(R * W) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate enforces unique word counting per response and stable tie-breaking.
